channel.title: Four of Hearts Interactive News
channel.description: Company and game news from Four of Hearts Interactive.

item.title: Commander ThumB Is Coming to Four of Hearts Interactive
item.description: Meet a brand-new 4OH game: an original one-thumb arcade adventure across the mysterious Thum System.

item.title: Welcome to the Thum System
item.description: Three related worlds orbit one star: Thum A invades, Thum B defends, and Thum C watches.

item.title: Building Commander ThumB: One Thumb, One Ship, 1,000 Levels
item.description: The design promise behind Commander ThumB is immediate control, escalating spectacle, and a long campaign built for mobile play.

item.title: Why We’re Building Palace
item.description: A familiar card-table game deserves a modern home that respects its mystery, momentum, and many table traditions.

item.title: Palace Enters Founder Testing
item.description: The flagship Four of Hearts experience is in hands-on internal testing, with attention on clarity, feel, and the full table journey.

item.title: Meet the Four Games in the 4OH Family
item.description: Palace leads the table, with Hearts, Spades, and Euchre bringing three distinct kinds of strategy to the studio.

item.title: Building a Safer, Family-Friendly Card Table
item.description: How Four of Hearts approaches clear policies, restrained data use, accessibility, and honest Internal Alpha communication.

item.title: Welcome to Four of Hearts Interactive
item.description: Meet the South Dakota studio building Palace and a growing family of timeless card-table experiences.
